title: Quiz: Dictionaries and Maps
description: Check your understanding of Dictionaries and Maps.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Assembly?
questions.explanation: In Assembly, ; marks a comment. Block comments use ; (line comments only).

questions.question: What is a dictionary/map best for?
options: Fast lookup of values by a unique key
Storing items in sorted order only
questions.correctAnswer: Fast lookup of values by a unique key
questions.explanation: Key-based lookup is O(1) on average — far faster than scanning.

questions.question: True or False: Dictionary keys must be unique within one dictionary.
Fill in the blank: scores["amy"] = 95  // "amy" is the ___
questions.explanation: The left side of the pair is the lookup key.

questions.question: In Assembly, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
